We live in a world where a janky game, full of bugs, with terrible servers, a toxic community, and a developer who himself doesn't understand how he managed to assemble such a project, can be more interesting than 90% of other online games out there.

In 10 years, barely anything has changed here, but at least there's no heavy-handed casualization, no pink latex anime gun skins, no pet companions, no stupid, useless collaborations that break the lore. Hell, who are we kidding, there is no lore to begin with :)

BSG sure know their marketing—the trailers are beautiful, the sound design is top-notch, the atmosphere is incredibly cool. In this game, everyone and everything is against you; you come here solely to suffer. But when you go back to play default shooters like CoD, you realize how plastic and toy-like everything feels there.

Playing PvE with friends for a couple hundred evenings is a solid plan. And if you're already into BDSM and other forms of suffering, go for the PvP and get your fill.

I'd recommend trying it, especially if you can get it on sale.

Aside from being a total mess bug-wise, server-wise, anticheat-wise, it's the best FPS ever made. It's what CS was in its time in terms of innovation and the one true king in it's category. Don't get carried away with streamer opinions, remember that they have different mindsets and time available, learn at your own pace and have realistic goals (if any). Everyone should try this game at least once in their life if they have even the slightest interest in survival/hardcore games. Get standard if unsure, invest in Unheard if completely sure. You do need a good PC though, don't expect constant 200fps+ even with am5 and all the latest toys. GLHF
